Messages.Author: The Nosferatu Stuff
Messages.Body:
If I have millicent smith, and I bleed. My prey manages to block.
Am I able to play a change of Target to cancel the action and block, and got
get burned up by millicent?

Messages.Author: Austin-007
Messages.Body:



I say no. It seems to me that by the time you would be able to play
CoT Millicent has already burrned you.

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 22 Jul 2001 14:38:05 GMT, "The Nosferatu Stuff"
<roans...@yahoo.com> wrote:


Text on Millicent:

"Unique Master. At the end of your turn, your predator takes control
of Millicent. If the Methuselah controlling Millicent has any of his
or her acting vampire's actions blocked, then Millicent and the acting
vampire are burned without combat."

Text on Change of Target:

"Only usable when this acting minion is blocked. Untap the acting
minion, do not tap the blocking minion, and cancel the current action
and combat. This minion cannot take the same action again this turn."

...since CoT requires a successful block, Millicent will burn the
vampire who was blocked.

-- Derek
